title: I built an AI game creator that lets you keep developing the game instead of stopping at the first generation
author: leogoman
selftext:
I've been building Plaxzy Creator, an AI tool made specifically for creating browser games.

One of the main things I wanted to solve was what happens after the first generation. Instead of generating a game once and then having to work with the code, you can play what Plaxzy builds and keep developing it just by telling the AI what you want changed.

There are different creation modes depending on how ambitious the game is. Quick is for simpler games, while Full and Pro can spend more time planning and building larger games with more systems, content and visual detail.

One feature I'm especially interested in getting feedback on is **Visual Edit**. You can draw or mark directly on the game and tell the AI what you want changed, so you don't have to describe the exact object or position through text.

A big challenge has been getting the AI to think like a game creator rather than just a code generator. I've been working on separate planning for gameplay, world design and visuals, as well as additional build and design passes for the more advanced modes.

Games work on desktop and mobile, and Full and Pro games can get a direct shareable link.

Creator starts at $2.99/month, and you can also get a Quick Creator Pass for **free** by inviting 3 friends.

**Also, if you're actually interested in testing it and giving me feedback, leave a comment or message me. I'm happy to give a few people here free access so I can see what you build and where it breaks.**

I'd especially love feedback from people already experimenting with AI game development.

[plaxzy.com/create](http://plaxzy.com/create)
